import pandas as pd

import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset

# Identify the rows corresponding to the relevant indicators
indicator_names = [
    "Exports of goods and services (annual percentage growth)",
    "School enrollment, primary (percentage gross)",
    "School enrollment, secondary (percentage gross)",
    "Labor force participation rate, total (percentage of total population ages 15+) (modeled ILO estimate)"
]

# Filter the dataset to include only the rows with the relevant indicators
filtered_df = df[df['Series Name'].isin(indicator_names)]

# Reshape the dataset to have years as rows and indicators as columns
pivot_df = filtered_df.pivot(index='Country Code', columns='Series Name', values=[col for col in df.columns if col not in ['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Series Name', 'Series Code']])

# Flatten the multi-index columns
pivot_df.columns = [f"{col[1]}_{col[0]}" for col in pivot_df.columns]

# Reset the index to make 'Country Code' a column
pivot_df = pivot_df.reset_index()

# Drop rows with missing values
pivot_df = pivot_df.dropna()

# Select only the numerical columns for correlation analysis

correlation_matrix
